adaptation: Focused public numerical replay. Tree formulas and frozen-input validation are adapted from original n00ak_core.py; vectorized formulas and randomized algebra checks draw on the separate original clean-room implementation. Conditional functions are newly named, parameterized by an arbitrary common coefficient, and explicitly do not claim derived physical beta functions. verify_public.py is a new focused driver with independent spectral-sum, algebra, domain, frozen-source, and coefficient-nonidentification checks. Original historical theorem reports and parent archives are not imported or required.
scientific_scope: Tree identities and conditional matrix consistency only. No new UV loop amplitude or physical beta coefficient is derived.
source_materials: N00AK research package supplied by the author; exact archive provenance is documented at release level.
